meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑和格式化 Word 文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码生成或处理 Word 文档。
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and format Word documents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate or process Word documents programmatically.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能创建、读取和编辑 Word 文档(.docx 和 .dotx);生成带目录、标题、页码等格式的文档,也能提取内容、插入或替换图片、查找替换文字,并处理修订和批注。
howto.when: 当你说到“Word 文档”“.docx”“.dotx”等词,或要求生成带目录、页码等格式的报告、信函、模板等文件时触发;也用于提取内容、插入图片、处理修订批注等需求。

say.text: 帮我新建一份 Word 文档,带目录和页码。
say.note: Claude 会调用 docx 脚本生成文件。

say.text: 读取这个 .docx 文件,提取里面的所有标题。
say.note: Claude 会先用 pandoc 读取内容。

say.text: 在 Word 文档里加一条批注,并接受所有修订。
say.note: Claude 会调用相关脚本处理批注和修订。

howto.what_en: Claude can create, read, and edit .docx/.dotx files, generate documents with TOC, page numbers, or letterheads, extract/reorganize content, insert/replace images, find/replace text, and manage tracked changes and comments.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "Word doc", ".docx", ".dotx", or a request for a formatted Word deliverable (report, memo, etc.). Also for extracting content, inserting images, or handling tracked changes/comments.

say_en.text: Create a new Word doc with TOC and page numbers.
say_en.note: Generates a .docx via the docx script.

say_en.text: Read this .docx file and extract all its headings.
say_en.note: Uses pandoc to read and list the content.

say_en.text: Add a comment in the Word document and accept all tracked changes.
say_en.note: Runs the comment and accept-changes scripts.
